name: proj-standards
description: Project Git & engineering standards for Claude Code, Codex and multi-agent teams: Conventional Branch 1.1.0 naming and worktree hygiene (git-branching), Conventional Commits 1.0.0 with per-milestone atomic commits and shared-workspace commit guards (git-committing), secret/size/private-file stage checks, SemVer releases and zero-dependency hooks via the repoguard CLI (repo-hygiene).
